title: Kingstone Companies, Inc. 8-K Filing
summary: Kingstone Companies, Inc. (ticker: KINS), a micro-cap property and casualty insurance company listed on Nasdaq Capital Market, filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026 announcing a fourth amended and restated employment agreement with CEO Meryl Golden. The agreement extends her employment term from January 2027 to January 2029, maintains her base salary at $550,000, and provides for restricted stock grants of 40,000 shares each in January 2027 and 2028.
key_points: CEO Meryl Golden's employment agreement extended from January 10, 2027 to January 10, 2029
Base salary remains $550,000 annually; annual bonus equal to 3% of consolidated operating income before taxes, capped at 1.25x base salary
Restricted stock grants: 40,000 shares in January 2027 (vesting over 2 years) and 40,000 shares in January 2028 (vesting after 1 year)
Change of control provision: 1.5x annual salary plus accrued bonus
Company is a property and casualty insurer based in Kingston, NY with common stock traded on Nasdaq Capital Market
Filing was signed by CFO Randy Patten on April 20, 2026
